translate_en|mods/HydeCoJobFair/42/media: Lets a job from another mod start where one of ours does. Their job's id, equals sign, our job's name, separated by commas. Example: exoticdancer=Club Dancer. Needs Vanilla Jobs Start at Work Too on.
When you press Play, ask whether to start at work or at home. Off: you start at work whenever your job has a workplace anywhere on the map. Single player only.
Zombies are kept out of the whole building you start in for the first few minutes. The game on its own clears only part of a big building. Single player only.
Vanilla Jobs Start at Work Too
The game's own jobs and other mods' jobs also start at work: a police officer at the police station, a chef in a kitchen. Off: only Job Fair jobs do.

Jobs to remove from character creation, separated by commas. Example: Cult Leader, Barber. A group name hides the whole group: Airport, Coalfield, Criminals, Medical, Retail, Sports and the rest. Unemployed is always kept.
Job Fair traits to remove from character creation, separated by commas. Example: Chatterbox, Old Soul.
None of Job Fair's 28 traits can be picked at character creation, so only the jobs are added. Traits that come with a job are kept.
Adjust All Job Costs also changes the game's own jobs and other mods' jobs, Unemployed included.
Changes the points of every Job Fair job at once. Negative numbers make jobs cost more points, positive numbers cost fewer. Example: at -2, a job that costs 4 points costs 6. 0 = no change.

Set the points of any job yourself. Job name, equals sign, points, separated by commas. Example: Cult Leader=-6, Barber=-2. Negative costs points, positive gives points. Works on the game's own jobs too.

Turn on before removing Job Fair, or characters made with it will not load. Load and save each character once: Job Fair traits are taken off and Job Fair jobs become Unemployed (skills and items stay). Then remove the mod. On a server, every player must log in once.
Job Fair jobs start with the tools of their trade, the key to their workplace, and for some jobs a work vehicle parked nearby.

Story jobs start the way their story says: the Hospital Patient sick, the Evacuee filthy and hungry, the Just Married drunk, the Escaped Inmate bloodied, and so on. Off: everyone starts healthy and clean.

Job Fair jobs also start with a bag for their trade (a medic bag, a toolbox, a cooler) with extra supplies and an everyday weapon (a frying pan, a pipe wrench, a golf club). Free, like the game's starter kit.

Your character starts at their workplace instead of at home. If the town you picked has no workplace for your job, you start at the nearest one in another town. Jobs tied to one place (Coalfield, the country club, the airport) always start there.

When you start at work, this many of your coworkers have already turned: zombies in their work clothes, somewhere in your building, a few seconds after you arrive. 0 = none. Above 0, Clear Zombies from Workplace is skipped.
Start your first day at work, or at home?
